Method of Attack: Execution of a fileless backdoor running in system memory
Evades detection by checking registry for sandbox clues and delaying execution
Collects system details, searches running processes, downloads and executes payloads from C2 server
Impacted Systems: Compromised networks of government, legal, religious organizations, NGOs, telecommunications, legal, pharmaceutical sectors
Attack Vector: Initial access through Microsoft Exchange server exploiting known vulnerability on unpatched machines
DLL side-loading via VLC Media Player with a malicious DLL file
Deployment of a custom malware loader
Use of WinVNC server for remote control
Use of tools like RAR archiving, WMIExec, NBTScan for reconnaissance and exfiltration
